integrity: All 65536 subsets enumerated independently by distance codes and bitmasks; 96 automorphisms and 192-state exchange graph exhaustively checked. No unproved generalization.
limitations: Finite exact classification for the sixteen-vertex Möbius-Kantor graph only; historical priority outside indexed literature is not certified. One 2016 paper uses a weaker pure definition, explicitly distinguished here. NetworkX 3 is used in the independent Python verification. No independent audit.
title: Three geometric types and a uniform seven-move exchange radius for weak-total metric bases of \(GP(8,3)\)
